# SCI-POINT To Telescope-QC Envelope

Identity: `SCI-POINT_TO_TELESCOPE-QC v0.1/r0.3`

POINT may publish exact fitted centroid, amplitude, effective shape,
constraints, identifiability, uncertainty availability, residual/response
state, parent/method/source identity, and lifecycle facts when those products
are available.

The named telescope/observing-condition QC process owns parameter admission,
reference populations, expected values, thresholds, comparisons, aggregation,
trend analysis, alerts/actions, and causal interpretation. POINT does not infer
a unique telescope, atmosphere, detector, calibration, filtering, or observing
cause from a deviation.

The QC named use may be eligible with prescribed action
`diagnostic_display_only` independently of pointing-correction and
photometric-transfer eligibility. That action cannot rescue either other use.
Missing numerical compatibility authority currently makes all fit-derived QC
metrics unavailable; generic QC role definitions remain valid.
